notes.title: Announcing new free game! Run Bird Run!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/28825135/ced9186fbaeb242d02b3cf7b56b842fb9bf04366.gif[/img]

Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː

I plan to release some of my past unreleased projects for free. The first one out will be Run Bird Run, and it is now available to wishlist. You can then add it to your library when it is released!

I need to adjust some things and add Steam Achievements, etc., before release.

Hopefully, this is just the first of many of my past unreleased projects I can put out, and I hope to do it for my previous unreleased titles as well!ːPfishː


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312100/Run_Bird_Run/


You can also follow my [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/varagtp]Steam Developer Page[/url][/b] to get automatically notified of any of my releases! ːPcatː

notes.title: New Teaser Trailer for No Life
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/28825135/1d70c5c2a59e6b9e49a0f652006c283e62f48115.gif[/img]

Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː

As stated in my previous post, No Life is still in development, perhaps too early to be shown properly, but I still wanted to put out a short teaser trailer with some small action from the game. You can now see the teaser on the No Life Steam store page! 

Currently, the teaser only shows one weapon (the pistol) and one zombie type (the normal slow one), but I actually have four weapons and about eight different zombie types in the game currently. However, I need to create proper graphics and polish them up before I can show them, which I hope to do in the next teaser. 

I am also working on the dog companion. ːPdogː 

I plan to have a playtest and then a demo for the game later on to gather feedback and ideas. You can wishlist the game and/or join the Discord to get notified when the playtest and demo are available! ːPfrogː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1256730/No_Life/

notes.title: Announcing my new game and more things to come!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/28825135/3ca3722edd6bea39b77dda2a7f533019c3740058.gif[/img]

Hi everybody! ːPhhelperː

I don't have a regular "devblog" but I wanted to share some news on what I am working on next and also some notes on the future. 

I just recently updated the store page for my next game "No Life" which will be a survival roguelite with zombies and will be a departure in terms of being a bit (lot) more gruesome than my other games.. (though the zombies are still quite cute in their own way). 

You will also be able to have a dog companion in the game! ːPdogː Keep in mind that what is shown so far is still very early and unfinished but I wanted to put the page up to be able to gather wishlists during the development. The final game will have many different zombie types, weapons and equipment and I plan to have an open playtest to gather feedback later before releasing a demo. Please consider wishlisting the game if it looks at all like something you might enjoy as it helps me a lot! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1256730/No_Life

I also have several smaller unreleased games that I plan to dose out over time on Steam. I plan to release them for free. Instead of gathering dust it would be fun if people could actually play them ːPduckː  They are mostly quite small in scope and I need to polish them up a bit and add Achievements for Steam but I hope to release the first one quite soon. Please follow my Steam Developer page if you want to be keept up to date on them as you will then automatically receive an email when they are released!

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/varagtp

I am also working in parallel on Animal Diner and after No Life and Animal Diner are done I plan to start on Plantera 3 ːPfishː

That is all for now! ːPhelperː

notes.title: Bees and Status Update on Plantera 2
notes.notes:
⠀⠀⠀    ⠀   ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀   ⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/fc6323db5fea38e99a796b07dd8eebe8f548ecf9.gif[/img]

Hi everybody. ːPhelperː

Wanted to drop another status update on Plantera 2 since it was a couple of months since the last one! Progress is going good even though I know I have wildly underestimated the time frame! I wrote a post about it in the forums since I get questions about the status of the game: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1091920/discussions/0/2264689848049975753/?ctp=10

I am still mostly working on fixing bugs and polish but I did get to implement something fun also that I mentioned in the last update. The bees. The bees will collect nectar from the plants and return to their hive to produce honey. 

Just a little bit longer now..! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/91f5579d181cdd4c4483396804bd2d5fc6b2af16.png[/img]
